title: omp-dashboard configuration, schemaVersion 1
description: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/omp-dashboard/config.json (or the file OMP_DASHBOARD_CONFIG names). Every key is optional except schemaVersion. Holds no secrets: the ntfy topic lives in its own 0600 file. Environment variables OMP_DASHBOARD_* override the file (see the README).

host.description: The address the hub binds. Loopback only: the hub speaks plain HTTP and refuses to start on any other address. To reach it from another device, put tailscale serve or an SSH forward in front of it.

port.description: The port the hub listens on.

adapter.description: Who may even ask. loopback-only: the pairing cookie alone, on a loopback Host. tailscale-serve: requests must come through Tailscale Serve and name this machine's owner, besides the cookie. both: a request with any sign of a proxy is judged by the tailscale-serve rules, one with none by the loopback-only rules; the local address keeps working while Tailscale is off.

allowedHosts.description: Extra host:port values the browser may use, for an SSH forward on another local port.

bin.description: Absolute path of the tailscale command. null: found on PATH, then the macOS app bundle.

servePort.description: The https port of `tailscale serve` that forwards to the hub. null: the same number as listen.port.

owner.description: Owner login. null: read from Tailscale. With publicHost, the hub does not ask Tailscale for the owner or the name (pair --tailnet and doctor still ask whether it is running).

publicHost.description: This machine's MagicDNS name. null: read from Tailscale.

dir.description: The pairing store (pairing-store/1). null: <config dir>/pairing. To let omp-private-relay accept the same browsers, point its pairing.dir here and set its pairing.mode to shared.

cookieName.description: The cookie that holds the browser's session id. omp-private-relay in shared mode must use the same name.

maxAgeDays.description: A paired browser is no longer paired this many days after it was paired (the cookie expires then too). null: never. omp-private-relay in shared mode does not apply this limit.

localMaxAgeDays.description: With auth.adapter both: a browser paired on the local address is no longer paired this many days after it was paired (never more than maxAgeDays; its cookie expires then too). The local cookie is not Secure and goes to every service on 127.0.0.1. null: the same limit as maxAgeDays. Not used with the other adapters.

bin.description: Absolute path of omp. null: OMP_BIN, then PATH.

dir.description: omp-session-control's control directory (session-control/1). null: OMP_SESSION_CONTROL_DIR, then ~/.config/omp-session-control. Stop and Rename need it.

enabled.description: Offer Open and Watch through omp-private-relay. Off: sessions are listed, and no link is ever handed out.

hostPort.description: The relay's host listener (where omp sessions connect). omp's collab.relayUrl must be ws://127.0.0.1:<this>.

guestPort.description: The relay's guest listener (where browsers connect).

checkDir.description: The relay's check directory (relay-check/1). null: <config home>/omp-private-relay/check.

webUrl.description: The address a browser uses for the relay's web client, and omp's collab.webUrl. null: http://127.0.0.1:<guestPort> with loopback-only, https://<name>:<servePort> with tailscale-serve. With both and relay.admits tailnet: the address for browsers that come through Tailscale Serve (null: https://<name>:<servePort>).

servePort.description: With tailscale-serve, or both with relay.admits tailnet: the https port of `tailscale serve` for the relay's guest listener. null: guestPort.

admits.description: With auth.adapter both only: which browsers the running omp-private-relay admits. local: its sign-in is the one for direct browsers on this machine's own address (Open and Watch are offered to them only). tailnet: its sign-in is tailscale-serve, so browsers that come through Tailscale Serve (offered to them only). A relay admits one way; the other gets a message instead of a link.

backend.description: How Start opens a new session: in a herdr tab, in a tmux window, or not at all.

roots.description: Folders Start may open sessions in: each one, and every git repository below it. Empty: nothing can be started.

maxDepth.description: How deep below a root to look for git repositories.

bin.description: Absolute path of herdr. null: HERDR_BIN, then PATH.
Absolute path of tmux. null: PATH.

session.description: The tmux session Start adds windows to (created when it does not exist).

rankBySessions.description: Order the Start list by recent use. Reads only the names and modification times of the folders in omp's session directory, never what is in them.

server.description: The ntfy server. https only (http only to loopback, for tests). Alerts name the project folder and the model to this server.

topicFile.description: The file that holds the ntfy topic (a bearer secret, 0600). null: <config dir>/secrets/ntfy-topic. Alerts are off while the file does not exist.

minTurnSeconds.description: A finished turn alerts only when it ran at least this long.

url.description: Where a stock `omp stats` is reachable from your browser. The Usage page links there; the hub never talks to it. null: no link.

maxBytes.description: The log moves to <file>.1 when it passes this size (one previous file is kept).

name.description: The name shown in the banner. null: omp's collab.displayName, else this machine's host name.
